findings.failure_condition: When an MCP tool completion contains a failed payload with a long error string, the Adapter formats `success=false; error={error}` without applying bounded_text, so ToolCompleted.output can exceed the 64 KiB UTF-8 body limit.
findings.required_behavior: Preserve the original MCP error text while applying the same 64 KiB UTF-8 truncation boundary used for other tool output paths.

test_assessment.applicability: Applicable to this Rust-only change, with the MCP error-output branch remaining uncovered and reported as the finding.
test_assessment.boundary: The checks exercise the local Rust Adapter and its projection boundary; they do not cross the later Node or Android product boundary, which is outside this S1 step.
test_assessment.necessity: The frozen four-check set was required for the Rust path-preservation and output-budget claims; no additional persistent test was admitted.
test_assessment.oracle: Existing assertions independently compare exact raw path values and preserve the 64 KiB UTF-8 budget for command output; they do not assert the budget for MCP error output.
test_assessment.reason: The cumulative change updates existing Rust adapter assertions; the selected checks are relevant, but they do not exercise a long MCP error payload.
test_assessment.reuse: The changed conformance and rollout-blocker tests are existing Rust test files reused by the frozen claim slots, with their path-preservation oracles updated for raw values.
